items.stem: Developments in technology now tie us ______ than ever before.
items.rule: than 要求比较级：close 的比较级是 closer；closely 的比较级是 more closely。
items.trap: 别写 more close；close 的比较级直接加 -er。

items.stem: We can text. We can talk to each ______ at the push of a button on WeChat.
items.rule: each other 是固定搭配「彼此」，不能写成 each another 或 each others。
items.trap: another 是「另一个」，不能与 each 连用。

items.stem: There are, of course, advantages to these modern ways of communicating. ______, do we ever think about what we are losing?
items.rule: However 是副词，句首独立时加逗号；But 是连词，不能这样带逗号独立使用。
items.trap: But 虽也表转折，但句首独立加逗号用 However；So/Then 是顺承。

items.stem: Moreover, while texts come and go, letters can ______ forever.
items.rule: letters 是被保留的对象，情态动词后表被动用 be kept。
items.trap: can 后不能直接跟 kept；被动要 can be done。

items.stem: After they walked a few miles, the wise man told the young man ______ back and kill the cow.
items.rule: tell sb to do sth，不定式作宾语补足语。
items.trap: tell 后不能跟光杆动词 go，也不能用 going。
items.src: 育才实验20-21·语法选择（越秀）

items.stem: You see, we are ______ than before.
items.rule: than 前用比较级；much 修饰比较级，better 本身已是比较级。
items.trap: much more better 是双重比较，广州卷最爱设的错项。
items.src: 育才实验20-21·语法选择（越秀）

items.stem: We have a cow. We ______ her for five years.
items.rule: for five years 表持续到现在，用现在完成时 have kept。
items.trap: 上文是 We have a cow（现在的状态），for five years 才落到现在完成时。
items.src: 育才实验20-21·语法选择（越秀）

items.stem: As someone who likes writing and ______ letters, I often feel sad.
items.rule: and 连接平行成分：likes 后 writing 与 receiving 都用动名词。
items.trap: likes 后接 doing；平行结构两边形式必须一致。

items.stem: To begin with, there's lots of love in ______ handwritten letter.
items.rule: handwritten 首音是辅音 /h/，可数单数泛指用 a。
items.trap: 冠词按读音不按字母，元音音素前才用 an。

items.stem: A few years ago, the young man ______ travelled on the same road decided to visit the family.
items.rule: 先行词 the young man 指人，定语从句用 who。
items.trap: 人用 who，物用 which；where 只能指地点。
items.src: 育才实验20-21·语法选择（越秀）

items.stem: If you follow what ______ above, you will be accepted by people around you.
items.rule: what 引导主语从句按单数，被动用 is given；主句将来时，从句用现在时。
items.trap: what 作主语按单数用 is；if 从句表示将来也不用 was/were。

items.stem: When you step into a new environment, you must have a strong wish ______ in.
items.rule: wish to do 是固定搭配，不定式作 wish 的宾语。
items.trap: wish / hope / decide 后接 to do，不接 doing。

items.stem: Spend some time ______ about your strong points.
items.rule: spend time doing sth，spend 后固定接动名词。
items.trap: spend time 后不用 to do，也不用动词原形。

items.stem: Optimism makes both you and other people ______ pleased.
items.rule: make sb do sth，使役动词后接省 to 不定式。
items.trap: make 后不加 to；变被动 be made to do 才把 to 补回来。

items.stem: And expecting ______ to be perfect can add to your stress level too.
items.rule: expect others to be perfect：others 泛指「别人」，后不接名词。
items.trap: another 是单数「另一个」，不能泛指一群人。

items.stem: In her opinion, if you don't talk to someone about your problems, you ______ worse.
items.rule: if 从句用一般现在时，主句用一般将来时（主将从现）。
items.trap: 从句里出现 will 就是错；will 只能放主句。

items.stem: She says her problems ______ in the future with others as much as possible.
items.rule: in the future 提示将来，problems 是被分享，用 will be shared。
items.trap: 被动将来是 will be done，别漏掉 be。

items.stem: Do you think your time is not enough ______ you have so many things to do?
items.rule: 后句说明原因：事太多导致时间不够，用 because 引导原因从句。
items.trap: 后句是原因不是条件；若读成 if 条件句，语义正好相反。

items.stem: ______ you cannot keep away from stress, you can keep it under control.
items.rule: 前后让步：虽躲不开压力，但能控制它，用 Although。
items.trap: Although 不与 but 连用；However 后需逗号且不能连接两句。

items.stem: “______ more careful next time!” she said.
items.rule: 祈使句以动词原形开头：Be more careful。
items.trap: Being / To be 都不能单独构成祈使句。
